reviewMethod: Independent manual review of every complete captured answer and returned source against the stated expectation and current main behavior. HTTP status and article matching were not used as semantic scores.

scoringPolicy.pass: The answer addresses the intended question or accurately explains its current product/scope limitation, without materially incorrect instructions.
scoringPolicy.partial: The answer is partly useful but omits a required material intent or condition.
scoringPolicy.fail: The answer misses the intended task, invents unsupported behavior, or contradicts current main.

samplingNote: This is a fixed regression set, not a blind benchmark or an estimate of overall accuracy. Additional questions were written separately, but their expectations were shared with the implementer before repair and execution. Expectations were updated to the current main feature set.
limitations: All captured answers used deterministic knowledge mode; no real AI-provider quality, cost, or availability is established.

A pass on an unavailable-feature question means the limitation was explained correctly; it does not mean dish editors, shopping editors, reusable templates, PDF export, or automatic messaging were implemented.
The 84-question captures do not contain the recent change/adjust compound-intent and medication-note examples. Those are separately covered by support-response unit tests and are not counted here.
This assessment covers API answer semantics and returned source metadata. It does not establish browser source-panel behavior or database workflow correctness.
observations: Shopping guidance correctly uses automatic saving and Retry save instead of an obsolete Save control.
Menu-revision guidance retains menus, votes, matching assignments, and covered purchases, pauses updates, and requires new purchase checks for increased quantities.
Room-retention guidance correctly takes the later of creation plus seven days and scheduled gathering plus 72 hours.
Compound questions receive both relevant topics, detailed follow-ups expand steps, and unrelated intervening questions end earlier menu context.
Some simple questions receive article-length guidance, but no material intended answer is omitted in this set.
